summary.headline: Lunar Tables and Magical Texts
summary.text: Description of folios 49–237 of a Neapolitan codex: lunar-cycle tables attributed to Solomon, astronomical computations, ecclesiastical writings and saints’ lives, an amulet, zodiac-sign diagnoses, lecanomancy, magical formulas, prayers and exorcisms, arcane characters, and isopsephy.
